chapter_schema.total_seconds: measured padded duration, ceil to 30fps boundary
chapter_schema.last_speech_end_s: provider boundary or documented sample-based estimate

cues.timing_basis: provider boundary/actual segment duration; be explicit

audio_generation_gate: locked_script.json must contain current script SHA and separate Codex/Claude content pass receipts
render_gate: source/time validation and representative scene QA pass; full media review remains pending
upload_gate: current final MP4 + caption SHA, Codex + Claude final review passes, zero required issues, private-only job
brand_assembly: reuse clean intro/outro assets; insert intro after opening hook using real cue boundary; apply one global offset map to media/captions
claims: Do not mark sampled frames as continuous playback or automatic ASR as actual listening.
